synopsis: 30 CFR 57.14132, discussed alongside 56.14132, is in force for US metal and non-metal mines and covers horns and backup alarms, including alternatives or an observer [f2770, f2771]. Chapter 3 specifies that self-propelled mobile equipment with an obstructed rear view requires a reverse-activated alarm, specified alternatives, or an observer; the glossary restates this requirement without the equipment and visibility qualifications [f2237, f15512]. Reverse alarms must be audible above surrounding noise [f2238, f2772]. These provisions do not require automatic braking, so the cited rules establish alarm-related requirements rather than an automatic-braking mandate [f2773].

relations.note: Glossary restates the reverse-alarm requirement, omitting equipment and rear-view qualifications.
Both require alarms to be audible above surrounding noise.
Specifies reverse activation and obstructed rear view within the broader alarm provisions.
Adds horn coverage to the glossary's reverse-alarm summary.
Adds the audibility condition to the glossary's alarm requirement.
Clarifies that the alarm provisions do not mandate automatic braking.
